name: Debra
story: Debra is a bright and energetic 10-year-old girl who adds a spark of joy to the office every day. She loves helping out wherever she can and always has a big smile on her face. Debra enjoys drawing, playing outside, and spending time with her friends and family. She is a quick learner and takes pride in her work, always striving to do her best. Debra is a valuable member of our team and we are lucky to have her on board.
